title: steplock session state
description: Runtime state for one checklist scope (.steplock/sessions/<scope-key>/state.json).

checklist.description: Identifier of the checklist this scope is tracking (matches the directory name under .steplock/checklists/).

current_state.description: Name of the Mermaid state node currently being gated. Written by steplock on each block; advanced by ack.sh on each acknowledgment.

next_state.description: Auto-advance target for linear states (single outgoing transition). null for branching states — agent must pass the chosen state as $1 to ack.sh.

transitions.description: Valid next state names from current_state. ack.sh validates $1 against this list.

visited.description: State node names already acknowledged this scope. Written by ack.sh.
